conclusions.conclusion: Fixed prefix and normalized GCD tickets partition the eligible NFT cohort. q*W+r equals the entire actual amount; current balance/liability bounds outstanding tags. No lifetime accumulator or claim-order allocation exists.

Normalizing equal-rarity cohorts avoids avoidable skew when each ideal NFT share is already an integer. For indivisible units, deterministic rotating tickets define the approved rounding policy; exact fractional promises are not made.

The cutoff freezes the pre-deadline activation cohort lazily before any late activation can join. An unavailable currency catches up to that cutoff before late entrants. Receipt balance observation cannot reconstruct the timestamp of transfers unseen until later; first late observation may include later receipts under the documented cohort rule.

Constructor and pre-admission balances stay distinct unallocated original-currency units until reviewed allocation. allocateAllUnallocated selects all eligible orphaned units of one admitted asset, never earned liabilities or opening-pool backing.

Optional unreadable currencies defer registration while activation continues. Unseen funds go to the prior eligible cohort on recovery, before newcomers join. Selected broken/taxed/rebasing/frozen tokens can revert; healthy currencies remain separately claimable.

Export flattens outstanding tree rights into whole accrued units without mutating the source, preserving abort. Rows preserve original activation ordinals and one-based ticket intervals; import rejects duplicate ordinal/tickets, malformed rows, invalid cursor and claim/liability mismatch. Funded integrated handoffs use synthetic LP venues, not real-v4 qualification.

The real outer Vault payee callback exposed a deadline change after the NFT check. Six-word policy fingerprint binds policy, NFT, receiver, end and monotonic local revision; end restoration cannot revive an old review. V8 imports reset that local review revision because minting is already closed and target addresses change.

Completed abort can leave late/prefunded receipts at cancelled importer addresses. The fixed-coordinator hook now moves only actual remaining currency to a reviewed authenticated active canonical receiver. Ops coordinator retains route cursor, restored backing, current governance and pre/post cohort checks; no arbitrary recipient capability.

Stored immutable-hash-bound creation bytes keep the factory runtime below EIP170. No caller-provided code/salt/recipient or mutator is introduced. Deployment gas increases materially and needs target-chain qualification.

No universal guarantee covers unsupported pathological currencies, zero eligible beneficiaries, intentional mint/grace holding, inaccessible owners, target gas capacity, actual marketplace behavior, production services or independent approval. Capacity64 is a bounded engineering ceiling requiring measured review, not proven universal safe operation.
